title: CRYSTAL QUEST – THE LOST KINGDOM
one_line: A Match-3 fantasy adventure: restore the Lost Kingdom with a short, satisfying daily session.
description: Swap crystals, make special crystals, use boosters and beat bosses to rebuild the broken Crystal Heart across five magical worlds. 100 levels in 12 kinds of challenge (collect, break blocks, treasure, rescue, glowing paths, forest healing, timed rounds and more), a daily reward streak, a new daily puzzle every day, and a kingdom that comes back to life as you win.
how_to_play: Swap two neighbouring crystals to match 3 or more. Reach the goal before your moves run out.
